package internalapi

import (
	"bytes"
	"crypto/sha256"
	"encoding/hex"
	"encoding/json"
	"io"
	"mime"
	"net/http"

	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain"
	studentuc "github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/usecase/student"
	"github.com/go-chi/chi/v5"
	"github.com/google/uuid"
)

// Planner plans may contain five items with up to one hundred target refs;
// keep enough bounded room for their canonical JSON representation.
const diagnosticReserveBodyLimit int64 = 512 << 10

func (handler *Handler) ReserveDiagnosticAssessment(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	w.Header().Set("Cache-Control", "no-store")
	if handler.DiagnosticAssessments == nil {
		http.Error(w, "diagnostic assessments are not configured", http.StatusServiceUnavailable)
		return
	}
	mediaType, _, err := mime.ParseMediaType(r.Header.Get("Content-Type"))
	if err != nil || mediaType != "application/json" {
		http.Error(w, "invalid request body", http.StatusBadRequest)
		return
	}
	body, err := io.ReadAll(io.LimitReader(r.Body, diagnosticReserveBodyLimit+1))
	if err != nil || int64(len(body)) > diagnosticReserveBodyLimit {
		http.Error(w, "invalid request body", http.StatusBadRequest)
		return
	}
	decoder := json.NewDecoder(bytes.NewReader(body))
	decoder.DisallowUnknownFields()
	var plan domain.DiagnosticAssessmentPlan
	if err = decoder.Decode(&plan); err != nil {
		http.Error(w, "invalid request body", http.StatusBadRequest)
		return
	}
	if err = decoder.Decode(&struct{}{}); err != io.EOF {
		http.Error(w, "invalid request body", http.StatusBadRequest)
		return
	}
	studentID, planID := chi.URLParam(r, "studentID"), chi.URLParam(r, "planID")
	if plan.StudentID != studentID || plan.ID != planID {
		http.Error(w, "invalid request body", http.StatusBadRequest)
		return
	}
	requestID := r.Header.Get("Idempotency-Key")
	parsedRequestID, parseErr := uuid.Parse(requestID)
	if parseErr != nil || parsedRequestID.String() != requestID || requestID != planID {
		http.Error(w, "invalid idempotency key", http.StatusBadRequest)
		return
	}
	sum := sha256.Sum256(append([]byte(r.Method+":"+r.URL.Path+":"), body...))
	attempt, _, err := handler.DiagnosticAssessments.Reserve(r.Context(), studentuc.ReserveDiagnosticAssessmentInput{Plan: plan, RequestID: requestID, RequestHash: "sha256:" + hex.EncodeToString(sum[:])})
	if err != nil {
		writeDiagnosticInternalError(w, err)
		return
	}
	w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	_ = json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(struct {
		Schema       string `json:"schema"`
		ID           string `json:"id"`
		PlanID       string `json:"plan_id"`
		PlanRevision int    `json:"plan_revision"`
		PlanDigest   string `json:"plan_digest"`
	}{"student-diagnostic-assessment-reservation.v1", attempt.ID, attempt.PlanID, attempt.PlanRevision, attempt.PlanDigest})
}
func writeDiagnosticInternalError(w http.ResponseWriter, err error) {
	switch err {
	case domain.ErrNotFound:
		http.Error(w, "not found", http.StatusNotFound)
	case domain.ErrConflict:
		http.Error(w, "conflict", http.StatusConflict)
	case domain.ErrValidation:
		http.Error(w, "invalid request", http.StatusBadRequest)
	default:
		http.Error(w, "diagnostic assessments unavailable", http.StatusServiceUnavailable)
	}
}

func (handler *Handler) GetDiagnosticAssessmentResult(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	w.Header().Set("Cache-Control", "no-store")
	if handler.DiagnosticAssessments == nil {
		http.Error(w, "diagnostic assessments are not configured", http.StatusServiceUnavailable)
		return
	}
	studentID, attemptID := chi.URLParam(r, "studentID"), chi.URLParam(r, "attemptID")
	if !canonicalDiagnosticInternalID(studentID) || !canonicalDiagnosticInternalID(attemptID) {
		http.Error(w, "not found", http.StatusNotFound)
		return
	}
	attempt, err := handler.DiagnosticAssessments.Get(r.Context(), studentID, attemptID)
	if err != nil || attempt.Result == nil {
		http.Error(w, "not found", http.StatusNotFound)
		return
	}
	w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	_ = json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(attempt.Result)
}

func canonicalDiagnosticInternalID(value string) bool {
	parsed, err := uuid.Parse(value)
	return err == nil && parsed.String() == value
}
